explication: This repository is the source for the Kubernetes website and documentation. Its principal workflow is that readers browse the published site, whose pages draw on English and translated documentation plus related content such as blogs, releases, case studies, and community resources. API-reference assets and configuration support the documented reference pages. The tree and README establish these product areas, but the sampled source does not show Hugo’s page-rendering or deployment wiring, so those relationships are not inferred here.
